result: DEFER: R-F1..R-F7 remain gated. The 2026-07-28 artifacts were produced with force_decision=GO and empty commands, so they are feasibility notes, not approved work. R-F8, R-F9 and R-F10 are shipped.
notes: Corrections against current official documentation (2026-11-15): portable SIMD (`std::simd` / portable-simd) is still nightly-only, so R-F4's 'stabilised in Rust 1.89' premise is false on stable Rust; the existing 8-way unrolled cosine loop remains the supported optimisation. OpenTelemetry Rust 0.33.1 made OTLP logs/metrics stable but traces are still beta, so R-F2 needs a pinned 0.33.x dependency plus an `otel` feature and redaction tests before it can be scheduled. crates.io trusted publishing is live and R-F10 is already shipped (ADR-078). R-F1/R-F3/R-F5/R-F7 need a schema or transport ADR and coordinated releases; R-F6 MoE routing needs its own ADR above ADR-077's exact-provider model. Do not promote any of them from a forced-GO artifact.
